text: Francesca has her second interview at the bank on Thursday at 10am. She sounded really nervous about the presentation part. Remind me to text her good luck on Wednesday night.
Kofi started at the agency on Monday. He says the team is lovely but the commute is brutal.
Camila's boss announced he's retiring at Christmas. She thinks she might be in line for his job.
Mai got the promotion! Senior designer from the 1st of next month.

Call with Florin this afternoon. His leaving drinks are on Friday at 6pm at the Crown, and he starts the new role in Bristol the Monday after. He's a bit sad to be leaving the team, especially Callum, who he's worked with for nearly six years. He said Bristol was too good to turn down though, and his partner already has a job lined up there.
Need to ask Nia how her assessment centre went yesterday.

Krisztina is applying for the head of finance job internally. Interviews are next Tuesday and Wednesday, and she's on Tuesday at 2pm. She's worried because the other candidate is her manager's favourite and has been there longer. She's been preparing every evening this week. I should offer to go through some practice questions with her on Sunday afternoon.
Amy mentioned her dad finally retires next Friday after 32 years at the council. They're doing a family meal on Saturday evening.
Michael's client meeting got cancelled again, third time this month. He's fed up.

Zoe hates her new manager. Apparently he micromanages everything, copies HR into every email and moved her desk without asking. She's started looking at other jobs quietly and has an informal chat with a recruiter next Thursday morning. She wants something in publishing ideally, she's always loved books.
Don't forget to send Ben the link to that job posting at the museum before Friday.
Olivia's first day at the hospital is tomorrow morning. Night shifts start the week after. I should drop her a message tonight.
Finn didn't get the job at the studio. He's gutted but they said he was a close second and they'd keep him in mind.
Pooja is off on maternity leave from the 14th. Her team is doing a little send-off on the Friday before at lunchtime.
Dentist moved to Thursday at 4:15. Need to leave work early.
Ines has been at the firm ten years this month. She's been quietly hoping someone notices. Must organise a card from the team before the 28th.

Varun's brother Anil has a phone interview with Google on Monday at 2pm. Varun said Anil hasn't slept properly all week and keeps rewriting his answers. It's for a data engineering role in their Dublin office, so he'd have to move if he gets it. Their mum is already planning the leaving party. Remind me to ask Varun on Tuesday how it went.
Femi and his wife both handed in their notice on the same day because they're moving to Lagos in the spring.
Wei told me her manager, Karim, is leaving at the end of the month to go travelling. Nobody knows who's replacing him yet.
Lin is thinking about going freelance. She loves illustration and wants to do it full time.
Rhys's performance review is on Wednesday at 11. He's convinced they're going to put him on a plan. Remind me to ring him Wednesday evening to see how it went.
Darius got offered the job in Manchester but turned it down. Said the money wasn't worth leaving his mum.
Ethan mentioned his boss's wife just had twins, so the boss is off for six weeks and Ethan is covering.
Tunde's retirement party has been called off; his wife is in hospital. Should check in with him at the weekend.
Rin has her final round with the consultancy in a fortnight. She asked if I could do a mock interview with her this weekend, maybe Sunday morning.
Callum is back at work after his knee operation. Still on crutches but in good spirits.
Anjali passed her probation today. Drinks on Thursday.

Bao's café job is ending when the place closes on the 30th. The owner is retiring and nobody wants to take it on. He's not sure what's next and seemed a bit low about it. He's been there since he left school. He mentioned he'd like to try something with cooking, maybe a commis chef role. Need to send him the details of that kitchen job Ethan mentioned.
Oisín starts his apprenticeship with the electricians next Monday at 7:30am. He's excited but terrified of the early starts.
Got the rejection email from the housing association job. Onwards. Applying for the two charity roles this weekend.
Francesca, or Frankie as everyone at work calls her, got the job! She starts on the 3rd of November.
Remind me to ask Kofi how his first week went, and whether his new manager is as intense as he feared.

Camila and her husband are both being made redundant from the same factory. The consultation meeting is on Tuesday at 9am. She's trying to stay positive for the kids. I want to take her for coffee after the meeting, maybe Tuesday lunchtime if she's up to it.
Mai's dog Biscuit is coming to the office on Friday for bring your dog to work day. She's been talking about it all week.
Florin is vegan, so when we book the team lunch for his last day, pick somewhere with proper options.
Michael Evans from the client side is leaving Petrov & Co. Their new account lead is Zoe Nakamura, starting on Monday.
Nia's sister Amy is graduating on the 18th and then starts a graduate scheme in London the week after. Nia is super proud.
Quick one: Ben is going for the team leader role. Applications close Friday at midnight and he still hasn't finished his statement. I need to read his draft tomorrow evening.
Krisztina said she'd love one of those fancy leather notebooks for her new office. Good leaving present idea.
Olivia and Finn are finally having their joint leaving do on Saturday night. Both off to new jobs in Leeds.

Had lunch with Pooja. She's been at the same company for eight years and is desperate for a change, but keeps finding reasons not to apply anywhere. Her husband thinks she's scared of starting over. She lit up talking about the volunteering she does at the animal shelter on weekends, so maybe something in the charity sector would suit her. She's also got her cat Pickle's vet appointment on Saturday.
Ines's mum is retiring from teaching next summer after nearly forty years. Ines wants to throw her a surprise party in July. I said I'd help with the playlist.
Varun is moving teams on Monday. New manager is a woman called Lin, apparently very strict about meetings starting on time.
Must book a haircut before the interview on Thursday. Also iron the blue shirt Wednesday night.
Femi had his interview yesterday afternoon. He thinks it went really well. I should message him on Friday to see if he's heard back.

Anil's manager offered him the team lead role but only if he relocates to Leeds. He has until the end of next week to decide. His wife isn't keen. Need to call him over the weekend and talk it through.
Wei's starting a part-time MBA alongside work in January. Lectures are on Tuesday evenings and every other Saturday.

Karim's leaving presentation was lovely. He cried a bit when they read out the messages from his old clients. Wei organised the whole thing and did an amazing job. He's got his first day at the new place on Monday morning, a startup in Shoreditch doing climate software. Must text him Monday evening to see how his first day went.
Rhys mentioned his girlfriend Rin is retraining as a primary teacher. Her course starts in September.
Darius has been signed off work with stress for two weeks. His manager has been awful to him since the restructure.

Ethan's new job at the bike shop is going really well. He's already been asked to run the Saturday workshops and the owner hinted at making him assistant manager in the spring. It's such a change from last year when he was stuck in that call centre and miserable. His girlfriend Zoe says he comes home actually happy now. They're celebrating with dinner on Friday.
Tunde's daughter has her first ever job interview tomorrow at 11 at the supermarket. He's more nervous than she is.
Callum said his manager is leaving in the new year and he's been asked to apply. Interviews are probably mid-January. Remind me to send him my old interview notes this week.

Anjali hates presenting. She has to pitch to the board on Friday at 3pm, which she's dreading, and then she's off to Spain on Saturday morning for a week. Text her good luck on Friday lunchtime, and ask how it went when she's back.
Note to self: update CV this weekend, then email the recruiter on Monday.
Bao finally got a reply from the hotel. Trial shift on Wednesday from 8 till 2.
Oisín's uncle runs a building firm and might have something for him if the apprenticeship falls through.
Mrs Ibrahim from accounts is retiring after 25 years. Collection going round until Thursday; I should put in a tenner and sign the card.
Big week. Team restructure announcement Monday at 9, my one-to-one with the director on Wednesday at half 2, then the offsite on Thursday and Friday. Keep Friday night free.

Spoke to Francesca again. The bank came back with an offer but it's less than she's on now, so she's going to negotiate. She'll call them back tomorrow morning. Her partner thinks she should just take it. Remind me to check in with her on Thursday.
